patthana15.28:1.1: anidassanaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassano na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. akusalaṃ kusalasadisaṃ.
patthana15.28:2.1: anidassanaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassano na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. sappaṭighaduka kusalattike nasappaṭighaduka nakusalattikaṃ
patthana15.28:3.1: appaṭighaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.28:4.1: appaṭighaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaṭigho na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.28:5.1: abyākate ekaṃ. rūpīduka kusalattike narūpīduka nakusalattikaṃ
